verdict.rationale: Graphite Agent does AI code review, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only manual levers for suppressing unwanted feedback: comment exclusions tell the agent where not to comment, and custom rules define guidelines it follows. Nothing shows the reviewer learning from a developer's reply or pushback, and acceptance-rate metrics are only reported. Missing for 10: learning from rejected comments or replies, automatic suppression of repeated dismissed feedback, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
